name: 5-HTP (5-hydroxytryptophan)
short: A safety review found no definitive toxicity cases in 20 years of use; a link to eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome is unresolved. One case report of serotonin syndrome with linezolid.
text: A safety review reported that no definitive cases of toxicity had emerged despite about 20 years of worldwide use of 5-HTP, with the possible exception of one unresolved case, and that analyses of several sources of 5-HTP showed no toxic contaminants similar to those associated with the 1989 outbreak of eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome traced to contaminated L-tryptophan. A systematic review of 5-HTP and tryptophan for depression nevertheless stated that the possible association between these substances and the potentially fatal eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome had not been elucidated and that further studies of safety were needed. A published case report (title only; no abstract available) describes a serotoninergic syndrome attributed to an interaction between linezolid and 5-HTP.
